summary: This stylesheet styles a feedback widget consisting of a container with a question, row of buttons, thank-you message, and vote counts. The comments note that this file is duplicated across two components and flag a fix applied to button hover states to use a theme-aware color variable instead of hardcoded white, which ensures proper contrast in both light and dark modes.

explanations.43: inline-flex makes the button shrink to fit its content while still allowing flexbox alignment of child elements inside it.
explanations.54: This starts a multi-line transition declaration that animates three properties smoothly when the button state changes.
explanations.63: object-fit: contain ensures the image scales proportionally to fit inside the 1.5rem box without cropping or distorting.
explanations.100: tabular-nums makes all numbers the same width so vote counts line up vertically, like on a digital display.
